Transactional Leadership
• Rewards and punishments are treated as
determinants of performance.
• Work by establishing clear structures and chain
of command.
• Assumptions-(i) People are motivated by
rewards and punishments; (ii) Social systems
work best with a clear chain of command; (iii)
when people have agreed to undertake an
assignment, a part of the deal is that they give
up all authority to the manager.

Transformational Leadership
• Transformational Leadership is about change and
innovation.
• Assumption
✓ People follow a person who inspires them
✓ A person with vision and passion can achieve
great things
✓ The way to get work done is by injecting
enthusiasm and energy.

Transformational Leadership
• Increase awareness of subordinates of the
importance of their tasks and the significance
of performing them well.
• Alert subordinates of the need for personal
growth, development, and accomplishment
• Inspire and stimulate subordinates to work for
the good of the organization.

Revitalization
• Dissatisfaction with the status quo.
• The process of transition is seldom smooth
• Accompanied by resistance from the
employees.

Creating a Vision
• Overriding principle that guides an
organization.
• Create a vision that critical mass of employees
accept willingly.
• The vision must correctly respond to
environmental pressures.

Institutionalizing the Change
• Dream must be translated into reality.
• Must gauge the psychology of the workers.
• Are result oriented and spend a lot of time
communicating.
• Engage in impression management.

Charismatic Leadership
• Those who exhibit certain personal traits,
abilities, and behavior and who have unusually
strong influence on followers’ emotions and
values.
• Model their own behavior for followers to
emulate by setting high performance
standards for themselves.
• Charisma matters enormously in start-ups and
turnaround contexts.

Servant Leadership
• Robert Greenleaf coined the term in the 1970s to
describe a leader who does not formally recognize
oneself as a leader.
• Is a form of democratic leadership.
• Humility is the key characteristic and focus.
• Attuned to people around and empathetically
understand what they are thinking.
• Motto-Serve to Lead.
